evals.prompt: Offline simulation only: read the skill and return an ordered action trace, reply/disposition mappings, thread states, and completion status. Treat the supplied repository and provider observations as fixtures. Do not call live GitHub/Azure, edit a real checkout, push, or wait in real time. The verified current PR head is H1. Its latest matching build B100 has successfully completed all required Heimdall review jobs and all configured lint/unit/Playwright checks. It posted one incorrect finding C1 in bot-originated thread T1; existing implementation and tests disprove it. A human also participated in T1. Human-originated unresolved thread T2 has a Heimdall reply but is outside this workflow. Disposition posting and T1 resolution succeed without code changes. Fresh discovery before completion returns only B100 for H1, all review attempts are terminal-successful, and both post-terminal thread scans show no actionable unresolved bot-originated findings. evals.expected_output: Reply to C1 and resolve T1, leave T2 untouched, verify final freshness and successful review, report observed CI separately, and finish without an empty commit or another review round.
expectations: Human participation does not prevent resolving T1, while human-originated T2 is ignored.
A reply-only resolution satisfies the no-outstanding-findings condition even though B100 originally produced a finding.
No empty commit, push or gratuitous new review run is requested.
The final result records the latest build and successful review separately from findings dispositions.

evals.prompt: Offline simulation only: read the skill and return an ordered action trace and completion status, including where sleeps would or would not occur. Treat provider observations and elapsed times as fixtures; do not call live GitHub/Azure, edit a real checkout, push, or wait in real time. The initial resolution pass is complete for verified head H6. Matching B600 has a failed lint prerequisite. Pipeline dependsOn/condition evidence confirms this prevents both applicable Heimdall jobs from running. A minimal safe repair, local validation, commit, and push succeed as H7. The immediate Azure/thread scan finds B601 queued and nothing actionable. At the next scheduled poll, all applicable Heimdall jobs succeeded, with the latest finishing at 10:00. Other lint/unit/component/Playwright checks and a containing stage remain running or pending. The immediate post-success thread scan at 10:00:30 finds incorrect finding C71 in bot-originated T71. Investigation, an evidence-based reply, resolution, and pass verification take three minutes without changing H7. A fresh scan is clean; final discovery/timeline confirm no superseding run or attempt. Describe repair authority, idle waits, findings, publication grace, and remaining CI.
evals.expected_output: Repair the lint prerequisite immediately because it demonstrably blocks review. Scan immediately after pushing H7; an idle queued-build delay is appropriate. Address C71 without polling sleeps between actionable steps. The publication deadline is 10:02; three minutes of work satisfy it. Take the final clean scan/freshness check without another sleep, finish review against H7/B601, and report other checks and the parent stage as running/pending.
expectations: The lint repair is justified by evidence it prevents applicable Heimdall jobs from running, not a blanket policy of repairing CI failures.
Monitoring H7 starts with an immediate Azure/thread scan after pushing.
A bounded polling sleep is appropriate only at the idle queued-build checkpoint, not between actionable repair or disposition steps.
C71 receives an immediate evidence-based disposition and eligible thread resolution.
Publication grace is anchored to the latest job finish at 10:00; three minutes of work satisfy the 10:02 deadline without another sleep.
Review completion uses H7/B601's successful applicable jobs and final freshness, independently of the running parent stage and pending CI; overall CI success is not claimed.
